headline: Citi Upgrades Motiva to Buy Following Post-Election Selloff
summary: Citi upgraded Motiva shares to a buy recommendation and lowered its price target from R$ 20.40 to R$ 17.40, following a near-30% plunge in the company's stock price after the elections.
why: Analyst recommendation adjustments following sharp market selloffs provide institutional perspectives on valuation disconnects and turnaround opportunities.

impacts.name: Motiva
impacts.why: An upgraded investment rating from a major financial institution can stimulate renewed institutional buyer interest.
